# Current bottom-right grid: R b b / R ? b / R b b

        r_max = max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])

print(f"Blue cells in bottom-right grid: {blue_cells}")

# Toggle all blue cells to red
if blue_cells:
    actions = [{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': r, 'col': c} for r, c, _ in blue_cells]
    result = action(actions)
    print("\nResult:", result)
    print("Level completed:", result.get('level_completed', False))
